options.label: symptoms-chart
options.fig.alt: Lollipop chart comparing the share of students with depression and anxiety symptoms across college, graduate, medical, and law students.

options.label: help-chart
options.fig.alt: Bar chart showing the share of students getting mental health help: about 60% of college students with symptoms, 36% of graduate students, about half of law students who needed help, and 15.7% of medical students who screened positive for depression.

options.label: licensure-loop
options.fig.alt: Diagram: licensure and bar questions about mental health history increase fear of disclosure, which delays help, which increases stress. Policy change that asks only about current impairment reduces fear of disclosure.
